definition: סַבְתָּה , סַבְתָּא proper name, of a people 3rd 'son' of Cush according to Gen 10:7 ( הָ֯ ), = 1Chr 1:9 ( אָ֯ ); identification with Σαββαθα [Periplus maris Erythr. 27 ], Σαυβαθα Ptol vi. 7, 38 , or Σαβατα [Strabo xvi. 42 ], Sabota [ Plin NH vi. § 155, xii. 63 ], old commercial city of South Arabia, by Tu Ku , but this = Sabean שבות (not ׳ ס ) Levy-Os ZMG xix (1865), 253 ; xx (1866), 273, compare Hal JAS 7, iv. 525 ; Glaser Skizze ii. 252 f. proposes Σαφθα ( Ptol vi. 7, 30 ), near west shore of Persian Gulf; ᵐ5 Σαβαθα , Σαβατα , Σεβαθα . All uncertain conjectures.
